materials.text: Count the affected stock, compare the result with the inventory system, obtain supervisor approval for adjustments, and record the approved change.
If the supervisor is away, I usually get the shift lead to sign it off. Different teams handle damaged stock a bit differently, depending on the situation.
Confirm the order, check refund eligibility, obtain the required approval, and record the refund in the payment system.
For a duplicate charge, I reverse the extra payment and add a note to the case. The standard guide doesn't explain how to handle it when the original payment is still pending.

scenarios.title: Routine equipment inspection
scenarios.responsibility: Complete and record daily equipment inspections

materials.text: Inspect the equipment using the approved checklist, record each result, report defects to the supervisor, and remove unsafe equipment from service.

Assessment criterion: independently complete the inspection, identify the seeded defect, and follow the safety escalation procedure. Outcome: passed. Evidence: completed checklist and observed practical assessment. Reviewer: safety supervisor. Verification status: confirmed.
